scope.summary: Implement the HBR acceptance-matrix hydration for the Tailor packet (applicable HBR-* rules -> acceptance rows).
acceptance_criteria: On packet hydration, applicable HBR rules auto-generate PACKET_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX rows keyed by rule_id.

The typed operation declares actor/session/correlation ids, expected base version, lease scope, idempotency key, preview/diff/apply semantics, cancellation/retry handles, and stale/conflict/error envelopes where applicable.
Negative, concurrent, partial-failure, retry, and recovery tests prove EventLedger/ArtifactStore effects are atomic, attributable, replayable, and leave no silent authority or orphan-artifact drift.
scope.risk_if_missed: No hydration means the build-rules gate cannot enforce Tailor obligations.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Validation, diagnostics, and visual inspection

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the validation/HBR catalog and receipts with tier-aware convergence, exact independent triangle contact checks, no-truncation/failure semantics, deterministic envelopes, accepted-step certificates, and all named adversarial cells.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
